title: Sum of Square Numbers
goal: Decide whether c is the sum of two nonnegative integer squares.
strategy: Compare the smallest and largest remaining squares. Move the endpoint whose change brings their sum toward the target.

phasePurposes.inspect: Compare the smallest and largest remaining squares. Move the endpoint whose change brings their sum toward the target.
phasePurposes.update: The two pointers exhaust the possible nonnegative square pairs.
phasePurposes.done: The two pointers exhaust the possible nonnegative square pairs.
